text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... The quiz is coming up soon, what 
should I do...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Studying for a test?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But lately I haven't been able to 
concentrate, so I haven't made any 
progress at all~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I was supposed to be looking 
something up on my phone, but before I 
knew it, I was scrolling through Umatter.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Before that, I got bothered by the messy 
room and started cleaning instead... You 
always wanna clean right before a test, 
right? Even when you never do it 
normally."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
How about... changing the environment you 
study in? If it is the library... there is 
no need to clean.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're right...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
And also—any off-task smartphone use— I 
shall monitor—and put a stop to.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... Everyone's staring right at me...! 
The tension is insane...!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I-It's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Don't look away, focus, focus!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Kuru... Hishi Miracle...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: It's about time—for the room to close.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Already!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: That was some magnificent—concentration.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you think so? There was just the 
right amount of tension, so I was able to 
focus really well.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-chan, thanks for hanging out with 
me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Miracle gained a new 
insight.
